entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-10
entry.content:
Issues

  • Build all projects for target architecture - remove all `AnyCpu` usage #53368
  • `dotnet tool exec` and `dnx` don't work if `dotnet-tools.json` happens to reference the same tool #53357
  • dotnet tool install crash with NRE in ToolConfigurationDeserializer #53355

Closed

  • dotnet workload restore failing with 10.0.101 #52090
